title: Rooting the ʿAqeedah: From Knowledge to Watchfulness
description: A path that roots the ʿaqeedah of your child (10–12) before bulūgh (puberty): from knowledge to watchfulness and conviction—faith-based identity, deep understanding of the arkān al-īmān (pillars of faith), ikhlāṣ (sincerity) and watchfulness, and riḍā bi-l-qadr (contentment with divine decree).

primary_reference.info: ثلاثة الأصول والقواعد الأربع لابن عثيمين، العقيدة الطحاوية، أسئلة الأطفال الإيمانية، أصول الإيمان على فهم السلف

review_defects.why: The Arabic uses the masculine singular 'ابنك' (your son), while the English uses the gender-neutral 'your child'. This may obscure the original intended audience or tone, though it could be a deliberate inclusive choice.
